payload.reason: Classification-based models were not used for the zero-shot experiments because they cannot resolve ties in predictions, which is essential for ranking tasks. Regression and ranking approaches provided better performance in cross-corpus and cross-lingual evaluations.

claims.text: Classification models cannot resolve ties in predictions, making them unsuitable for ranking tasks in zero-shot experiments.
Regression and ranking approaches outperformed classification in cross-corpus and cross-lingual evaluations, justifying their use over classification models.
